name: hh-meanrev-micro: range-position deep-oversold reversion, swing hold (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: reads overextension through RANGE LOCATION rather than dispersion — range_position pinned near the bottom of the recent high-low range means price has been pushed to a structural extreme of the range the market has been respecting, and the mechanical reaction is a snap back toward the range interior as forced/emotional sellers exhaust. On the 4h swing bar this is a slower, higher-conviction reversion than the intraday fades: the dislocation is a multi-hour overshoot, the hold spans hours-to-days, and the larger reversion comfortably clears round-trip cost. rsi confirms the location extreme is also a momentum extreme (not a slow drift to a new lower range). Entry: range_position below a fitted floor AND rsi below a fitted floor. Long-only spot; exit as range_position recovers into the range interior. DISCONFIRMER: if the range_position signal produces the same trades and net Sharpe as a plain bb_z fade at the same timeframe, the two are collinear and this adds nothing distinct — keep one. If the 4h reversion fails to beat buy-and-hold over the same windows, the range low was the start of a new lower range (a real breakdown), not an overshoot — kill.
catalyst: price pinned at the range low on the 4h swing bar snaps back into the range
